source.context: Project cards are authoritative local declarations; the catalog and graph are generated views that can become stale or incomplete.
source.expression: When an authored project card and a derived registry view disagree, retain the card as the declared source, report the mismatch, and regenerate or repair the view instead of hand-editing it.
source.intended_use: Keep registry maintenance pointed toward the declared source of each fact.

target.context: A compact label placed beside generated catalog or graph material.
target.expression: DERIVED — generated from project cards; check and report gaps; do not hand-edit.
target.intended_use: Give a reader one short word whose visible expansion carries the source-of-truth and repair rule.

transition.rule: Compress the registry dependency argument into the word DERIVED, but always display the expansion close enough that the word cannot masquerade as a truth guarantee.

preserved_relations.name: authority-direction
preserved_relations.source_form: Authored project card precedes generated catalog view for declared project facts.
preserved_relations.target_form: The expansion says the view is generated from project cards.
preserved_relations.test: Ask which artifact should be edited after a mismatch; the target must answer project card, not catalog.

preserved_relations.name: fallibility
preserved_relations.source_form: A generated view can contain gaps or drift.
preserved_relations.target_form: The expansion instructs the reader to check and report gaps.
preserved_relations.test: Introduce a missing card in a fixture; the label must not imply that generation made the view complete or true.

preserved_relations.name: repair-direction
preserved_relations.source_form: Repair the source or generator and regenerate; do not hand-edit the output.
preserved_relations.target_form: The expansion explicitly says do not hand-edit.
preserved_relations.test: Given a stale catalog row, a reader should choose source repair plus regeneration rather than editing the row.

loss_assessment.basis: Known compression losses are itemized below. The named invariant tests check authority, fallibility, and repair direction only; they do not recover the full reasoning chain or diagnose a particular registry mismatch.

discarded_structure.name: full-reasoning-chain
discarded_structure.consequence: The word does not carry the schema rules, generator behavior, exact provenance, or evidence for a particular mismatch; readers still need the linked sources.

discarded_structure.name: case-specific-diagnosis
discarded_structure.consequence: DERIVED does not say whether a particular divergence came from staleness, a parser defect, a missing card, or a wrong declaration.

transition.counterexample: If a reader treats DERIVED as certified truth, edits the generated file, or cannot discover the source card, the lexicalization has failed.
transition.stop_condition: Do not use DERIVED as a label for observed runtime state, a person's identity, or any record with no named generation path.

warrant.confidence_basis: The repository instructions and schema directly state the authority and regeneration boundaries represented by the label.
known_limits: This receipt tests whether the compact label carries declared relations; it does not prove that any generated view is current or correct.
Project cards are attributed declarations and do not prove operational location, ownership, runtime state, personhood, or inner identity.

freshness.reassess_when: Reassess if SCHEMA.md, the project-card authority rule, or the catalog generation path changes.

distortion_risks.mechanism: A terse badge can sound more certain than the longer source reasoning.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Keep the visible expansion and source link with the word.
distortion_risks.residual: A reader can still ignore the expansion or copy the badge without it.

distortion_risks.mechanism: The word can be reused outside registry generation, where its source-of-truth rule may not apply.
distortion_risks.mitigation: Scope the label to named generated artifacts and retain the stop condition.
distortion_risks.residual: Other projects may use DERIVED with a different local meaning.

repair.reply_route: Challenge this receipt in the owning KINGDOM-OS change or attach a challenge through an existing collaboration report.
repair.correction_route: Issue a new receipt with relation corrects, supersedes, or withdraws and retain this non-sensitive receipt in history.
